post.description: Creates a post for the site with a slug and author. Returns 409 when the slug already exists on the site. Content is authored separately via the draft endpoint.

get.summary: Gets a blog post by id.
get.description: Returns the post aggregate (routing metadata, cover, gallery, pending schedule) by its stable id. Returns 404 if it does not exist.

put.summary: Updates a post's slug, author and cover.
put.description: Replaces the routing/ownership metadata. Optimistic concurrency via ConcurrencyStamp; returns 409 on a stale stamp or a slug already taken on the site.

delete.description: Tombstones the post so it disappears from admin and public surfaces. Returns 404 if it does not exist.

put.description: Materialises a fresh draft after a publish, then upserts the culture's block-tree JSON, title and summary into it. Returns the stable draft version id. Returns 409 on a concurrent draft edit of the same culture.

post.summary: Attaches a media document to the post gallery.
post.description: Appends a media-library document to the gallery. Re-adding an already attached document updates its caption/alt text in place. Returns 404 if the post does not exist.

patch.summary: Updates an attachment's caption / alt text.
patch.description: Sets the caption and alt text of an existing gallery attachment. Returns 404 if the post or attachment does not exist.

delete.summary: Removes an attachment from the gallery.
delete.description: Detaches a document and renumbers the gallery. Returns 404 if the post or attachment does not exist.

put.description: Reorders the gallery to the given exact set of attached document ids. Returns 422 when the set does not match the post's attachments, 404 if the post does not exist.

post.description: Archives the prior published version, makes the current draft live and clears any pending schedule. Returns 422 when the post has no draft, 404 if it does not exist.
Archives the currently published version, leaving history intact. Returns 422 when nothing is published, 404 if the post does not exist.

post.summary: Schedules the current draft to auto-publish.
post.description: Records a wall-clock publication time in an IANA zone and registers the scheduled transition. Re-scheduling replaces a prior schedule. Returns 422 on an invalid zone or no draft, 404 if the post does not exist.

delete.description: Clears the pending schedule and its registered transition. Returns 404 if the post does not exist.

get.description: Returns a page of the current site's published posts for a culture, newest first, optionally filtered by author. Rich tag/category filtering is served by the search index. Anonymous.

get.summary: Gets a published post by slug.
get.description: Resolves the current site's published post for the slug and culture, with its block-tree content and media references. Returns 404 when unpublished, missing, or absent in that culture. Anonymous.
Returns the site's author profiles in display-name order.

post.description: Creates the public profile for a platform user on the site. Returns 409 when the user already has a profile there.

get.summary: Gets an author profile by id.
get.description: Returns the profile by its stable id. Returns 404 if it does not exist.

put.description: Replaces the display name, bio and avatar. Returns 404 if the profile does not exist.

delete.description: Tombstones the profile. Returns 404 if it does not exist.

get.summary: Returns a paged, filterable list of BlogPostListItemResponse from BlogPost.
get.description: Executes a dynamic query against BlogPost using the Granit query engine and projects each row to BlogPostListItemResponse. Accepts filter expressions, sort directives, column selection, pagination, and free-text search via query parameters. Returns a PagedResult<BlogPostListItemResponse> by default. When the groupBy query parameter is specified, returns a GroupedResult<BlogPostListItemResponse> with the same projection applied to the items inside each group.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. Ignored when cursor is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-500). Server-side cap applies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination. When supplied, overrides page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across searchable columns declared in the query definition.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort directives. Prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt,lastName').

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Field to group results by. When set, the response shape becomes GroupedResult instead of PagedResult.

parameters.name: quickFilters
parameters.description: Comma-separated quick-filter names (declared in the query definition).

parameters.name: skipTotalCount
parameters.description: Skip the total row count for faster pagination when the client doesn't need it.

parameters.name: presets
parameters.description: Bracketed preset selectors: 'presets[group]=name'. Applies preset filter groups declared in the query definition.

schema.description: PagedResult when groupBy is absent; GroupedResult otherwise.

get.summary: Returns query metadata for BlogPost (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for BlogPost: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

get.summary: Gets recent posts as an RSS 2.0 feed.
get.description: Returns the current site's most recent published posts for a culture as an RSS 2.0 document. Anonymous.
